title: Prophets timeline (one file per language)
description: Content for the landing-page timeline: Adam through Muhammad. One file per language (prophets.ar.json, prophets.en.json, prophets.de.json). Every file has identical ids and identical ordering; only the strings differ.

lang.description: BCP-47 language of every string in this file.

dir.description: Writing direction the UI must apply when this file is active.

translation.description: Provenance of non-Arabic files. Arabic is the source of record.

quranTranslation.description: The published Qur'an edition every verse in this file is quoted from. Present on translated files only — the Arabic file carries the Qur'anic text itself, which is not a translation. Its `attribution` string must be displayed wherever a verse appears.

source.description: The authored file this JSON was generated from.

id.description: Stable slug, identical across languages. Used in URLs and as the React key.

order.description: Position on the timeline. Narrative sequence as given in the source, NOT a claim about absolute dates — the Qur'an does not date most prophets.

name.description: Full honorific form, e.g. 'موسى عليه السلام'. Shown in the detail panel.

shortName.description: Bare name for the timeline circle, e.g. 'موسى'. Must stay short enough to fit inside the circle at all zoom levels.

namedInQuran.description: True only for the five books the Qur'an names explicitly. The source document is emphatic that revelation and a named book are different claims.

sinsAndPunishment.description: أبرز معاصي القوم والعقوبة. Inline markdown; ** marks key terms.

placeText.description: Verbatim place cell, including hedges like 'غير محدد قرآنيًا'. Always displayed; the map is secondary to it.

locations.description: Resolved ids into locations.json. Empty when the source says the place is not specified — the UI must then show no map, not a guess.

locationCertainty.description: quranic = the text itself names the place; traditional = attributed by later sources; unspecified = the source declines to locate it.

sins.description: Categories from section 6 of the source document. Used for filtering and for the zoomed-out overview.

lineage.description: Optional edges for the zoomed-out lineage view (section 3/4 of the source). Absent where the source gives no lineage.

detailPage.description: Id of a dedicated deep-dive page. Only 'muhammad' has one; the timeline renders that circle as a link into muhammad.*.json.

quranRefs.description: Qur'an references quoted in this entry, as "sura:ayah". Lets the UI link a quotation to its source. Identical across languages.
